title: Benchmarking Forecasting Agents on Yesterday's Tomorrows
abstract: arXiv:2610.40940v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Digital agents can now gather and organize information, reason over it, and use tools to complete complex tasks. Forecasting puts all of these abilities to the test: it requires integrating incomplete evidence, inferring causal drivers, and committing to calibrated probabilistic judgments. Existing benchmarks are poorly suited to measuring and improving this ability. Live benchmarks provide feedback only after events resolve, so every evaluation cycle waits on the calendar; fixed-corpus evaluations return results immediately but confine research to pre-collected documents. We introduce FABench, a scalable backtesting environment for Forecasting Agents. An automated pipeline discovers events, generates questions, and resolves outcomes for any past forecast date, so the benchmark can be renewed to stay ahead of model training cutoffs; its first release poses 287 questions across nine domains. translated_title: 基于“昨天的明天”对预测智能体进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 数字智能体现在能够收集和整理信息、对其进行推理，并使用工具完成复杂任务。预测能力是对所有这些能力的综合考验：它需要整合不完整的证据、推断因果驱动因素，并作出经过校准的概率判断。现有基准测试并不适合衡量和提升这种能力。实时基准测试只有在事件结果揭晓后才能提供反馈，因此每个评估周期都不得不等待日历的推进；而固定语料库评估虽然能立即返回结果，却将研究局限于预先收集的文档。我们推出了 FABench，一个面向预测智能体的可扩展回测环境。其自动化流水线能够发现事件、生成问题，并对任意过去日期的预测结果进行判定，因此该基准可以持续更新，始终领先于模型的训练截止日期；其首个版本涵盖了九个领域共287个问题。智能体可以在其中针对每个问题进行自由研究……
tldr: FABench是一个面向预测智能体的可扩展回测基准环境，通过自动化流水线为任意过去日期生成预测问题并判定结果，既解决了实时基准需等待事件揭晓的问题，也突破了固定语料库局限于预收集文档的限制。
en_tdlr: FABench is a scalable backtesting environment for forecasting agents that uses an automated pipeline to generate questions and resolve outcomes for any past forecast date, overcoming the calendar-dependent feedback of live benchmarks and the document limitations of fixed-corpus evaluations.
